agent_compatibility.evidence: Measured 2026-07-26 on Claude Code 2.1.220 with CommandMate 0.15.0: an installed skill is discovered from .claude/skills and matches in the slash palette. The installer writes .agents/skills and .claude/skills byte-identically, so the path is package-independent.

Measured 2026-07-26 on Codex CLI 0.145.0: SKILL.md is read from .agents/skills (model self-report, not a mechanical trace). This version does not expose skills as slash commands, so invoke it by name.
Not verified for this version. Readable as a procedure, discovery and reload unverified.

Measured 2026-08-25 on opencode 1.18.22 (CommandMate#2037) and re-checked 2026-09-04 on 1.18.27: GET /skill lists SKILL.md from .agents/skills and .claude/skills; submitting /<name> loads the skill. Scanned at boot, restart after install. Not in opencode's own slash palette.

Measured 2026-09-04 on Command Code 1.47.0 (CommandMate#2322): discovered from .agents/skills (cmd skills list, /skills picker); /<name> emits skill_loaded and runs. .claude/skills is not read; the installer's .agents/skills copy suffices. No restart needed.
